ionrift-respite.enrichment.alchemistsSup: Respite: Qualifies for the Alchemy crafting profession during rest. Characters proficient with these supplies can brew potions and concoctions during the Activity phase.
ionrift-respite.enrichment.bedroll.htmlC: Respite: Bedroll tracked for rest flavour. Comfort rules disabled. No HD bonus applied.
Respite: A character carrying a bedroll recovers +1 Hit Die during a long rest, regardless of camp comfort level. This bonus stacks with normal HD recovery.
ionrift-respite.enrichment.birdEggs.html: Respite: Perishable (1 day). Foraged or gathered from nests. Fragile and quick to spoil. Used as a cooking ingredient.
ionrift-respite.enrichment.choiceCut.htm: Respite: Perishable (1 day). A prime cut from an exceptional hunt. Spoils after 1 rest but produces superior meals when cooked. Higher-quality recipes may require choice cuts specifically.
ionrift-respite.enrichment.cooksUtensils: Respite: Qualifies for the Cooking crafting profession during rest. Comfort rules disabled. No exhaustion advantage applied.

Respite: A character carrying Cook's Utensils gains advantage on the exhaustion save during rest when the campfire is lit. Also qualifies for the Cooking crafting profession, allowing the character to prepare meals that grant temporary buffs.
ionrift-respite.enrichment.edibleBerries: Respite: Perishable (3 days). Foraged fruit. Can be eaten raw or used as a cooking ingredient. Spoils after 3 rests.
ionrift-respite.enrichment.edibleMushroo: Respite: Perishable (3 days). Foraged fungi. Can be eaten raw (with some risk) or used in cooking. Spoils after 3 rests.
ionrift-respite.enrichment.freshFish.htm: Respite: Perishable (1 day). Caught fresh from rivers or marshland. Spoils after 1 rest if not cooked. Used as a cooking ingredient for fish-based recipes.
ionrift-respite.enrichment.freshMeat.htm: Respite: Perishable (1 day). Raw game meat from hunting. Spoils after 1 rest if not cooked or preserved. Used as a cooking ingredient for recipes that call for meat. Cooking transforms it into a meal that feeds the party and may grant temporary buffs.
ionrift-respite.enrichment.healersKit.ht: Respite: Used during the Tend Wounds activity. Grants advantage on the Medicine check and adds 1d4 to the healing roll (1 charge spent). Characters with the Healer feat use the feat formula (1d6 + 4 + target level) instead.
Respite: Perishable (3 days). Medicinal herbs foraged in the wild. Used in herbalism recipes and some advanced cooking. Spoils after 3 rests.
Respite: Qualifies for the Herbalism crafting profession during rest. Characters proficient with this kit can gather and prepare herbal remedies, antidotes, and poultices during the Activity phase.
ionrift-respite.enrichment.messKit.htmlC: Respite: Mess kit tracked for rest flavour. Comfort rules disabled. No exhaustion advantage applied.

Respite: A character carrying a mess kit gains advantage on the exhaustion save during rest, but only when the campfire is lit. Without a fire, the mess kit provides no mechanical benefit. Functions identically to Cook's Utensils for this purpose.
ionrift-respite.enrichment.pavilion.html: Respite: A large pavilion tent provides Shelter during rest. Provides full weather protection and significantly reduces the encounter DC.
ionrift-respite.enrichment.rations.html: Respite: Consumed during the Meal Phase of a long rest. Each character requires 1 ration per day (some terrains require 2). Characters who go without food risk exhaustion after their grace period expires. Rations are automatically decremented during the rest flow.
ionrift-respite.enrichment.smokedFish.ht: Respite: Cured fish. Shelf-stable (does not spoil). Equivalent to rations for the Meal Phase. A cooking output that preserves fish for travel.
ionrift-respite.enrichment.spicedJerky.h: Respite: Dried, seasoned meat strips. Shelf-stable (does not spoil). Equivalent to rations for the Meal Phase. A cooking output that preserves meat for long journeys.
ionrift-respite.enrichment.tent.html: Respite: Provides Shelter during rest. Shelter reduces the encounter DC and can negate minor weather effects.
ionrift-respite.enrichment.tinderbox.htm: Respite: Tinderbox tracked for rest flavour. Comfort rules disabled. Fire phase is bypassed.

Respite: Required to light the campfire during the Camp phase. Without a tinderbox (or equivalent), the party cannot start a fire, losing access to cooking, warmth bonuses, and campfire-dependent activities. One tinderbox serves the whole party.
Respite: Qualifies for the Tinkering crafting profession during rest. Characters proficient with these tools can repair gear or craft small mechanical devices during the Activity phase.
ionrift-respite.enrichment.waterskin.htm: Respite: Used during the Meal Phase of a long rest. Each remaining use is 1 pint. A full waterskin holds 4. A character needs 8 pints a day (1 gallon); desert needs 16. Half that amount calls for a DC 15 Constitution save. Less than half is exhaustion, with no save. The rest spends those uses and leaves the waterskin on the sheet.
ionrift-respite.enrichment.wildBerries.h: Respite: Perishable (3 days). Foraged fruit. Can be eaten raw or used as a cooking ingredient. Spoils after 3 rests. Recipes using berries tend to produce preserves that last longer.
ionrift-respite.enrichment.wildHerbs.htm: Respite: Perishable (3 days). Aromatic herbs foraged in the wild. Essential cooking ingredient for many recipes. Also used in herbalism. Spoils after 3 rests.
ionrift-respite.helpers.comfortHint.fall: Rest comfort affects HP and Hit Dice recovery.

ionrift-respite.helpers.comfortHint.roug: Rough: full HP, 1 fewer Hit Die back. CON save DC 10 or +1 exhaustion.
ionrift-respite.helpers.comfortHint.safe: Safe: full HP and Hit Dice back. No risk of a night event.
ionrift-respite.helpers.comfortHint.shel: Sheltered: full HP and Hit Dice back. A normal night.

ionrift-respite.helpers.fireTierPlain.ca: Cooking and warmth. Easier for enemies to spot (higher encounter chance).
